title: Major Shonen Jump Hit Gets New U.S. Release Schedule & Raises Its Chances of Getting an Anime
content: A major series from Shueisha’s library of Shonen Jump magazines is getting a newly updated release schedule in the United States, and with it has really raised its chances of getting an anime in the near future.
author: ComicBook

title: Pokémon Films Get BD Collection in November
content: Viz Media announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Tuesday that it will release a 16-disc limited edition Blu-ray collection of all 24 Pokémon movies released so far on Amazon exclusively on November 24. The disc collection comes with a special Pokéball-shaped container.
author: ANN

title: My Hero Academia: All's Justice Game Adds DLC Character Izuku Midoriya Overlay Full Style
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment announced on Wednesday that its My Hero Academia : All's Justice game will add DLC character Izuku Midoriya Overlay Full Style to the game on Thursday. The character is available as part of the season pass.
author: ANN

title: Bungo Stray Dogs Returns With Special Crunchyroll Trailer While Fans Wait on Season 6
content: Bungo Stray Dogs has kicked off a celebration for a major milestone, and Crunchyroll is going all out for the occasion with a special trailer showing off how far the anime has come over the last decade.
author: ComicBook

title: Sunao Katabuchi's 'Fukufuku no Chizu' Anime Short Streams with English Subtitles on YouTube
content: The official YouTube channel for the prefecture of Fukushima began streaming " Fukufuku no Chizu " (Map of Fukufuku), director Sunao Katabuchi 's new anime short , with English subtitles on Monday. The official website for the short posted the animation in Japanese on March 24.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Darkest Series Gets Brand New Look After Netflix Revival
content: MAPPA is one of the biggest animation studios in the industry, and its popularity keeps increasing with several exciting projects. The studio’s most popular anime is Jujutsu Kaisen , which contributed significantly to its groundbreaking success.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll's Anime Nights Program to Screen Black Clover Season 2, The Vermilion Mask, More on September 21
content: Crunchyroll announced on Tuesday that its " Crunchyroll Anime Nights" program dedicated to screening anime across the U.S. will screen the following anime ahead of their fall releases on September 21.

title: Bleach’s Final Season Confirms Finale Is Coming Soon & Fans Need to Be Ready
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has been taking the anime world by storm ever since it made its debut with its final season this Summer , but its grand finale is coming much faster than many fans might be ready for.
